commands.name: Connect to PostgreSQL
commands.description: Connect to a PostgreSQL database; psql prompts for a password if needed.

commands.name: Connect to a local PostgreSQL database
commands.description: Open an interactive psql session to a local database.

commands.name: List PostgreSQL databases
commands.description: List databases accessible to the current PostgreSQL user.

commands.name: List PostgreSQL tables
commands.description: List tables in the selected database.

commands.name: Run a SQL file with psql
commands.description: Execute SQL statements from a file against the selected database.

commands.name: Back up a PostgreSQL database
commands.description: Create a custom-format PostgreSQL database backup.

commands.name: Restore a PostgreSQL backup
commands.description: Restore a custom-format backup into the selected database. Review target contents first.

commands.name: Drop a PostgreSQL database (destructive)
commands.description: Permanently remove a PostgreSQL database. Verify the database name and backup first.
